Days Past Due Threshold for NPA
GL Accounts (accountant-configured - required before GL posting works)
fields.description: These must be set to real accounts in this Company's chart of accounts. Left blank until an accountant confirms the correct account names/structure - see corporate/polaris/docs/gl-posting-report.md. GL posting throws a clear error rather than guessing if any of these are unset when needed.

fields.label: Loans Receivable Account
fields.description: Asset account representing principal owed to the company by borrowers. NOT the same as a generic trade Accounts Receivable account - loan principal is a distinct balance-sheet line from customer invoice AR.

fields.label: Interest Income Account
fields.description: P&L income account credited when interest is accrued (recognized as earned, regardless of whether cash has been collected yet).

fields.label: Interest Receivable Account
fields.description: Asset account debited when interest accrues and credited when that accrued interest is actually collected via repayment.

fields.label: Disbursement/Repayment Bank Account (override)
fields.description: Optional override. If unset, GL posting uses this Company's default_bank_account (ERPNext's own standard field). Only set this if loans for this specific product move through a different account than the company's main bank account.
